q: Where were you when the train crossed midnight, and who walked past your cabin?
answer: I was in the dining car, having dinner, when the train crossed midnight. I didn't notice anyone specific walking past, but Tomás Reyes, the night porter, came in to grab a cup of coffee around that time. I was focused on my meal, so I didn't pay much attention.

q: Onde você estava entre a parada das 23h e a meia-noite, e quem passou pelo corredor?
answer: Eu estava na minha cabine-leito, a sleeper 7, o tempo todo. Não saí dela durante a noite. A Helena passou pela minha porta quando as luzes voltaram, mas não vi ninguém mais no corredor.
